description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2022-07-19' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY-MM-DD' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 1 of the EVALUATE TRUE at L128-L149: FC-INVALID-DATE, whose 88-level VALUE is X'0000000000000000' (L62) and which - despite its name - is the SUCCESS token, because the halfword SEVERITY and the halfword MSG-NO it decodes to are both zero. The date and the mask are the pair both online callers actually pass: CORPT00C at L392 and L412 and COTRN02C at L393 and L413 each move 'YYYY-MM-DD' into CSUTLDTC-DATE-FORMAT. The 19 July 2022 date is the revision marker this very file carries in its Ver: footer at L156.
